cohort: 102 one-year-old preterm VLBW and ELBW infants and 87 one-year-old full-term NBW infants
finding: One-year-old preterm VLBW and ELBW infants had significant differences in anamnestic, medical, and oral health compared to full-term NBW infants, including a higher prevalence of developmental defects of the enamel and deformations of the hard palate.
